```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork) #adding ggplot figs together
library(lme4) #models
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 15))
library(AICcmodavg) #for AIC model selection
library(gt) #for saving tables in a word doc
library(here) #for reading/saving files in a directory
```

```{r}
climate <- read.csv(file = here("cleaned_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"), header = T)
climate <- climate %>% 
    mutate(year = as.character(year)) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(year>2015)
```


```{r read in data}
plec <- read.csv(file = here("cleaned_data", "Plectritis.density_scaled.csv"), header = T)
plec <- plec %>% 
  mutate(year = as.character(year),
         plot = as.factor(plot)) %>% 
  filter(plot!="12", 
         !(density == 0 & densityT1 == 0)) %>% 
  group_by(plot) %>% 
  arrange(plot,year) %>%
  mutate(trt = factor(trt, levels = c("irrigated", "control", "drought")),
         log.lambda = log(lambda1),
         log.total1 = log(total1)) 

bromus <- read.csv(file = here("cleaned_data", "Bromus.density_scaled.csv"), header = T)
bromus <- bromus %>% 
  mutate(year = as.character(year),
         plot = as.factor(plot)) %>% 
  mutate(trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought"))

plec <- left_join(plec, climate)
bromus <- left_join(bromus, climate)
```

```{r plec model selection}
seablush_base <- lmer(log.lambda ~ 1+(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush_density <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1 + (1|year) + (1|plot), data = plec, REML = FALSE)
seablush_density.q <- lmer(log.lambda ~ I(log.total1^2) + log.total1 + (1|year) + (1|plot), data = plec, REML = FALSE)
seablush_trt <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+trt + (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush_trt.int <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1*trt + (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush_trt.alone<- lmer(log.lambda ~ trt + (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

seablush1 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+spring.tot.precip +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.q <- lmer(log.lambda ~ I(log.total1^2) +log.total1+spring.tot.precip +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.1 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+spring.tot.precip + trt+ (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.2 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+spring.tot.precip *trt +(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.3<- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1*spring.tot.precip +trt + (1|year)+(1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.4 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1*spring.tot.precip +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush1.5 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ spring.tot.precip +(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

seablush2 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.mean.max.temp +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.q <- lmer(log.lambda ~ I(log.total1^2) +log.total1+summer.mean.max.temp +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.1 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.mean.max.temp + trt+ (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.2 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.mean.max.temp *trt +(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.3<- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1*summer.mean.max.temp +trt + (1|year)+(1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.4 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1*summer.mean.max.temp + (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush2.5 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ summer.mean.max.temp +(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

seablush3 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.tot.precip +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush3.q <- lmer(log.lambda ~ I(log.total1^2) +log.total1+summer.tot.precip +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush3.1 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.tot.precip + trt+ (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)
seablush3.2 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+summer.tot.precip *trt +(1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

seablush4 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+spring.mean.temp +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

seablush6 <- lmer(log.lambda ~ log.total1+winter.mean.min.temp +  (1|year)+ (1|plot), data = plec, REML = F)

models.plec <- mget(ls(pattern = "^seablush"))
plec_AICc<-aictab(cand.set = models.plec,second.ord=TRUE,nobs=NULL,sort=TRUE)

summary(seablush2.4)
summary(seablush3.4)

```

```{r}
summary(seablush2.4)
fixef(seablush2.4)
coefs <- summary(seablush2.4)$coefficients

plec_best <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(coefs),
  Estimate = coefs[, "Estimate"],
  SE = coefs[, "Std. Error"])
write.csv(plec_best, here("tables", "plectritis_best_fit_coeff.csv"), row.names = F)
```

```{r}
  rename(Model = Modnames) %>% 
    #mutate_at(3:8, round, 3) %>%
```

```{r plec figure}
#bootstrapping:
# set number of bootstrap samples:
boot = 1000
set.seed(12345)

###
#summary(seablush2)
#parametric bootstrap
#make matrix of random draws
plec_samp =as.data.frame(MASS::mvrnorm(n=boot, mu=fixef(seablush2.4), Sigma=vcov(seablush2.4)))
colnames(plec_samp)[1] <- "Intercept"
#plec_samp
# apply(plec_samp,2,mean) #double check that the means are similar to fixef
pred.dat.st <- expand.grid(log.total1.samp = seq(0, 7, by = .5), summer.mean.max.temp.samp = c(min(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T), max(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)))
pred.dat.st$Seq <- 1:nrow(pred.dat.st)

booted.p <- cross_join(pred.dat.st, plec_samp) %>% 
  rename(interact = 7) %>% 
  mutate(log.lambda = Intercept + summer.mean.max.temp.samp*summer.mean.max.temp+log.total1.samp*log.total1 + interact*log.total1.samp*summer.mean.max.temp.samp) %>% 
  group_by(Seq, summer.mean.max.temp.samp,log.total1.samp ) %>% 
  summarize(lower = quantile(log.lambda , 0.025),
            upper = quantile(log.lambda , 0.975),
            log.lambda = mean(log.lambda)) %>% 
  rename(log.total1 = log.total1.samp,
         summer.mean.max.temp = summer.mean.max.temp.samp)

(summer <- plec %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.total1, y = log.lambda))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, alpha = 0.25, linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_point(alpha= 0.6, shape = 1, aes(size = summer.mean.max.temp))+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 4)) +  # Adjust the size range as needed
  scale_color_manual(values=c( "lightskyblue", "indianred1"))+
  geom_line(data = booted.p, aes(x = log.total1, y = log.lambda, color = as.character(summer.mean.max.temp)), linewidth = 1.3)+
  geom_ribbon(data = booted.p, aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = as.character(summer.mean.max.temp)), linewidth = .75, alpha = 0.2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightskyblue", "indianred1"), guide = "none")+
  labs(x = bquote(""~italic(Plectritis)*" per "~m^2*" + 1"), y = expression(italic("Plectritis")~log(N[t+1] / N[t])), color = "Summer Temp")+
  guides(size = "none")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 3.3), breaks = seq(-2, 3, by = 1))+ 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = log(c(1, 5, 25,  100, 400, 1000)),  # Log-transformed ticks
  labels = c(1, 5, 25, 100, 400, 1000) )+
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black'), text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title=element_text(size=13), panel.grid = element_blank()))

ggsave(plot = summer, file = here("figures", "plec.summer.temp.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r tqe plectritis  summer maxtemp}
sigma <- sigma(seablush2.4) #Environmental variability not captured by summer temperature
Nc <- median(plec$total1) #97
Nx <- 5
tmax <- 30
NumReps <- 50000
# > min(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)
# [1] -1.961
# > max(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)
# [1] 1.129

set.seed(1234)

N.cool <- rep(Nc, NumReps)
N.warm <- rep(Nc, NumReps)

Extant.cool <- numeric(tmax)
Extant.warm <- numeric(tmax)

int      <- fixef(seablush2.4)["(Intercept)"]
sum.slope <- fixef(seablush2.4)["summer.mean.max.temp"]
dens.slope <- fixef(seablush2.4)["log.total1"]
interact  <- fixef(seablush2.4)["log.total1:summer.mean.max.temp"]

for (t in 1:tmax) {
  # COOL SUMMER
  eta.cool <- int +
    sum.slope * (min(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.cool) +
    interact * log(N.cool) * (min(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    rnorm(length(N.cool), 0, sigma)

  lambda.cool <- exp(eta.cool)
  N.cool <- N.cool * lambda.cool
  N.cool <- N.cool[N.cool > Nx]
  Extant.cool[t] <- length(N.cool)

  # WARM SUMMER
  eta.warm <- int +
    sum.slope * (max(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.warm) +
    interact * log(N.warm) * (max(plec$summer.mean.max.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    rnorm(length(N.warm), 0, sigma)

  lambda.warm <- exp(eta.warm)
  N.warm <- N.warm * lambda.warm
  N.warm <- N.warm[N.warm > Nx]
  Extant.warm[t] <- length(N.warm)
}

ProbExtinct.cool <- (NumReps - Extant.cool) / NumReps
ProbExtinct.warm <- (NumReps - Extant.warm) / NumReps

plectritis.qe <- data.frame(
  Year = rep(1:tmax, 2),
  Probability = c(ProbExtinct.cool, ProbExtinct.warm),
  Condition = rep(c("Cool", "Warm"), each = tmax))

# plot it
(pqe <- ggplot(plectritis.qe, aes(x = Year, y = Probability, color = Condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cool" = "lightskyblue", "Warm" = "indianred1")) + 
  labs(x = "Years", y = "Probability of Quasi-Extinction", color = "Summer Max Temp") +  
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black'), text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title=element_text(size=13), panel.grid = element_blank())+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent)) 
#ggsave(plot = pqe, file = here("figures", "plec.summer.temp.qe.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```

```{r PLECTRITIS }
sigma <- sigma(seablush3.4) #Environmental variability not captured by summer temperature
Nc <- median(plec$total1)#97
Nx <- 5
tmax <- 30
NumReps <- 50000
# > min(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)
# [1] -1.145
# > max(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)
# [1] 1.815

set.seed(1234)

N.cool <- rep(Nc, NumReps)
N.warm <- rep(Nc, NumReps)

Extant.cool <- numeric(tmax)
Extant.warm <- numeric(tmax)

int      <- fixef(seablush3.4)["(Intercept)"]
sum.slope <- fixef(seablush3.4)["summer.tot.precip"]
dens.slope <- fixef(seablush3.4)["log.total1"]
interact  <- fixef(seablush3.4)["log.total1:summer.tot.precip"]

for (t in 1:tmax) {

  # dry SUMMER (-2 SD)
  eta.cool <- int +
    sum.slope * (min(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.cool) +
    interact * log(N.cool) * (min(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)) +
    rnorm(length(N.cool), 0, sigma)

  lambda.cool <- exp(eta.cool)
  N.cool <- N.cool * lambda.cool
  N.cool <- N.cool[N.cool > Nx]
  Extant.cool[t] <- length(N.cool)

  # wet SUMMER (+2 SD)
  eta.warm <- int +
    sum.slope * (max(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.warm) +
    interact * log(N.warm) * (max(plec$summer.tot.precip, na.rm = T)) +
    rnorm(length(N.warm), 0, sigma)

  lambda.warm <- exp(eta.warm)
  N.warm <- N.warm * lambda.warm
  N.warm <- N.warm[N.warm > Nx]
  Extant.warm[t] <- length(N.warm)
}

ProbExtinct.cool <- (NumReps - Extant.cool) / NumReps
ProbExtinct.warm <- (NumReps - Extant.warm) / NumReps

plectritis.qe.sp <- data.frame(
  Year = rep(1:tmax, 2),
  Probability = c(ProbExtinct.cool, ProbExtinct.warm),
  Condition = rep(c("Dry", "Wet"), each = tmax)
)
# Create the ggplot
(pqe.sp <- ggplot(plectritis.qe.sp, aes(x = Year, y = Probability, color = Condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Dry" = "#B40F20", "Wet" = "#46acc8")) +  
  labs(x = "Years", y = "Probability of Quasi-Extinction", color = "Summer Precip") + 
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black'), text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title=element_text(size=13), panel.grid = element_blank())+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent)) 

#ggsave(plot = pqe.sp, file = here("figures", "plec.summer.precip.qe.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r bromus bootstrapped pop dyn}
boot = 1000
set.seed(12345)

#parametric bootstrap
#make matrix of random draws
br_samp =as.data.frame(MASS::mvrnorm(n=boot, mu=fixef(sterilis6), Sigma=vcov(sterilis6)))
colnames(br_samp)[1] <- "Intercept"
#plec_samp
# apply(plec_samp,2,mean) #double check that the means are similar to fixef
pred.dat.st <- expand.grid(log.total1.samp = seq(0, 7, by = .5), winter.mean.min.temp.samp = c(min(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T), max(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T)))
pred.dat.st$Seq <- 1:nrow(pred.dat.st)

booted.b <- cross_join(pred.dat.st, br_samp) %>% 
  mutate(log.lambda = Intercept + winter.mean.min.temp.samp*winter.mean.min.temp+log.total1.samp*log.total1) %>% 
  group_by(Seq, winter.mean.min.temp.samp,log.total1.samp ) %>% 
  summarize(lower = quantile(log.lambda , 0.025),
            upper = quantile(log.lambda , 0.975),
            log.lambda = mean(log.lambda)) %>% 
  rename(log.total1 = log.total1.samp,
         winter.mean.min.temp = winter.mean.min.temp.samp)

(winter.boot <- bromus %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.total1, y = log.lambda))+
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, alpha = 0.25, linetype = "dashed")+
    geom_point(alpha= 0.6, shape = 1, aes(size =  winter.mean.min.temp))+
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 4)) +  # Adjust the size range as needed
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#4059ae", "#f3b942"))+
  geom_line(data = booted.b, aes(x = log.total1, y = log.lambda, color = as.character(winter.mean.min.temp)), linewidth = 1.3)+
  geom_ribbon(data = booted.b, aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = as.character(winter.mean.min.temp)), linewidth = .75, alpha = 0.2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4059ae", "#f3b942"), guide = "none")+
  labs(x = bquote(""~italic(Bromus)*" per "~m^2*" + 1"), y = expression(italic("Bromus")~log(N[t+1] / N[t])), color = "Winter Min Temp")+
  guides(size = "none")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 3.4), breaks = seq(-2, 3, by = 1))+ 
    scale_x_continuous(    breaks = log(c(1, 5, 25,  100, 400, 1000)),  # Log-transformed ticks
    labels = c(1, 5, 25, 100, 400, 1000) )+
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black'), text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title=element_text(size=13), panel.grid = element_blank())
)
```

```{r bromus pva}
sigma <-sigma(sterilis6)

Nc <- median(bromus$total1) #69
Nx <- 5
tmax <- 30
NumReps <- 50000
# > min(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T)
# [1] -0.99
# > max(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T)
# [1] 0.915

set.seed(1234)

N.cool <- rep(Nc, NumReps)
N.warm <- rep(Nc, NumReps)

Extant.cool <- numeric(tmax)
Extant.warm <- numeric(tmax)

int      <- fixef(sterilis6)["(Intercept)"]
wint.slope <- fixef(sterilis6)["winter.mean.min.temp"]
dens.slope <- fixef(sterilis6)["log.total1"]

for (t in 1:tmax) {

  # COOL SUMMER
  eta.cool <- int +
    wint.slope * (min(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.cool) +
    rnorm(length(N.cool), 0, sigma)

  lambda.cool <- exp(eta.cool)
  N.cool <- N.cool * lambda.cool
  N.cool <- N.cool[N.cool > Nx]
  Extant.cool[t] <- length(N.cool)

  # WARM SUMMER
  eta.warm <- int +
    wint.slope * (max(bromus$winter.mean.min.temp, na.rm = T)) +
    dens.slope * log(N.warm) +
    rnorm(length(N.warm), 0, sigma)

  lambda.warm <- exp(eta.warm)
  N.warm <- N.warm * lambda.warm
  N.warm <- N.warm[N.warm > Nx]
  Extant.warm[t] <- length(N.warm)
}

ProbExtinct.cool <- (NumReps - Extant.cool) / NumReps
ProbExtinct.warm <- (NumReps - Extant.warm) / NumReps

bromus.qe <- data.frame(
  Year = rep(1:tmax, 2),
  Probability = c(ProbExtinct.cool, ProbExtinct.warm),
  Condition = rep(c("Cool", "Warm"), each = tmax))

# plot it
(bqe <- ggplot(bromus.qe, aes(x = Year, y = Probability, color = Condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cool" = "#4059ae", "Warm" = "#f3b942")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(x = "Years", y = "Probability of Quasi-Extinction", color = "Winter Min Temp") +  # Labels
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black'), text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title=element_text(size=13), panel.grid = element_blank())+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent)) 

ggsave(plot = bqe, file = here("figures", "br.wint.temp.qe.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

(bromus.together <- 
  (winter.boot+ theme(legend.position = "none"))+
  bqe + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")+
  theme(legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)))

#ggsave(plot = bromus.together, file = here("figures", "bromus.popdyn.png"), width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r climate summary - not included}
(climate.summary <- climate %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(season = sub("\\..*", "", variable),
    type = ifelse(grepl("precip", variable), "precip", "temp"),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("winter","spring","summer","fall"))) %>% 
    mutate(season = factor(season,
                         levels = c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter"))) %>% 
  filter(variable == "spring.tot.precip"|variable == "summer.tot.precip"|variable == "summer.mean.max.temp"|variable == "spring.mean.temp"|variable == "fall.mean.temp"|variable == "winter.mean.min.temp") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = type, group = variable))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~season)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#056c98", "#fb9124"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        #strip.text = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line=element_line())+
  labs(x = "", y = "Standardized climate", color = ""))
```
